features.title: Walk-forward recalibration with a pooled match-level calibration gate
acceptance: walk-forward recalibration: each season S starts from an isotonic map fitted on S-3..S-1 and is updated after every completed match (online logit-intercept adjustment); a match is scored only with matches completed before it; update settings tuned on 2023-2024 only; documented as the production method in docs/design-docs/models-and-grading.md
2025 and 2026 walk-forward predictions evaluated pooled (match as the sample unit) and reported per season (not gated per season)
(a) joint test of calibration intercept = 0 and slope = 1 with a match-clustered bootstrap is not rejected at the 5% level
(b) Brier score beats the exact model and is no more than 0.002 worse than the run-rate logistic baseline
(c) simulation on the same matches: a perfectly calibrated model passes >= 90% of the time
(d) the smallest shift detected with 80% power is reported and is <= 15 points
per-season results and the 2026 drift recorded in docs/QUALITY_SCORE.md; artifact versioned (data/models/calibration-v3.json)
features.evidence: Passes (D-038). npm run model:calibration → data/models/calibration-v3.json (sha256 ae09d66a967c); npm test -- calibration: 4 files, 22 tests pass and recompute the pooled verdict. η tuned on 2023–2024 = 0. 2025+2026 pooled, 138 matches: (a) Wald 2.11 < 5.99 (intercept 0.34, slope 1.13, match-clustered bootstrap 1,000); (b) Brier 0.116307 vs exact 0.181286 and run-rate logistic 0.127944; (c) calibrated pass rate 0.96 (200 sims); (d) min detectable shift 15 points. Per season: 2025 Wald 0.15, 2026 Wald 5.09 (slope 1.74). The first D-030 run scored the map window in sample and failed (a), Wald 7.45 (D-032); fixed after the Gate 2 review. docs/QUALITY_SCORE.md, docs/design-docs/models-and-grading.md.
features.acceptance_history: Until 2026-10-22 (owner decision D-027): calibration map fitted on training seasons (2008-2023) and versioned; held-out seasons 2024-2026: every 10-point bucket with >= 200 samples within 5 points; reliability diagram data exported for the Notebook. | D-027 (superseded by D-030): rolling-origin map on S-3..S-1 without looking at S; 2025 and 2026 gated separately with >=40-match buckets, 95% match-level bootstrap intervals, match-weighted error <= 5 points, Brier beating exact and run-rate logistic, and a fairness simulation; intent kept: each season tested out of sample at the match level.
